mapper.select: select c.id, c.media_id, c.person_id, c.credit_type, c.department, c.job, c.`character` character_name, c.cast_order, c.create_time, p.name p_name, p.profile_path p_profile_path, p.profile_local_url p_profile_local, p.tmdb_id p_tmdb_id from km_media_cast c join km_person p on p.person_id = c.person_id and p.del_flag = '0' where c.media_id = #{mediaId} order by c.credit_type asc, c.cast_order asc

select c.id, c.media_id, c.person_id, c.credit_type, c.department, c.job, c.`character` character_name, c.cast_order, c.create_time, m.title m_title, m.poster_path m_poster_path, m.poster_local_url m_poster_local, m.media_type m_type, m.release_date m_release_date from km_media_cast c join km_media m on m.media_id = c.media_id and m.del_flag = '0' where c.person_id = #{personId} order by m.release_date desc
mapper.insert:
insert into km_media_cast (media_id, person_id, credit_type, department, job, `character`, cast_order, create_time) values
(#{c.mediaId}, #{c.personId}, #{c.creditType}, #{c.department}, #{c.job}, #{c.character}, #{c.castOrder}, sysdate())
